reason: Adds separate image input token and cost fields to usage logs for image editing and image-to-image billing reconciliation.
risk: The migration adds two NOT NULL columns with defaults to the high-volume usage_logs table and can briefly block concurrent reads or writes while PostgreSQL acquires the required table lock.
mitigation: Both changes are additive and idempotent, use constant zero defaults that modern PostgreSQL can apply as metadata-only defaults, and preserve all existing billing totals. Deploy during the normal low-traffic window and retain health monitoring.
